title: Expected satisfaction of a linear constraint
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite set, and consider a constraint on $k$ distinct variables, where $1\le k\le r$, requiring the sum of their values in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to equal a specified right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$. Under a uniformly random assignment of elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $V$, the expected satisfaction indicator is $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The constraint has an injective scope
The constraint specifies a right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$
